name: vovk-python
description: Codegen templates for Python client library for Vovk.ts

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS) { console.error('Publish from CI: PACKAGE=<name> npm run <type> tags a release, and the tag publishes it'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.test: npm run unit:ts && PORT=3210 npm run generate && npm run build --prefix ../../test && PORT=3210 concurrently 'node ../../scripts/wait-for-url.mjs http://localhost:3210/api/foo/client/common/nested-query && npm run unit:py' 'npm run start --prefix ../../test' --kill-others --success first
